items.name: Process Lab: Launcher / Updater Killer Pack (Extended)
items.description: Closes an extended launcher/updater/browser/chat process set for gaming sessions.

steps.command: $names=@('Battle.net','Agent','Battle.net Helper','EADesktop','EABackgroundService','UbisoftConnect','upc','UplayWebCore','GalaxyClient','GalaxyCommunication','GalaxyClient Helper','OperaGXBrowserAssistant','browser_assistant','Spotify','WebHelper','Creative Cloud','CCXProcess','CoreSync','AdobeIPCBroker','Adobe Desktop Service','msedge','chrome','firefox','brave','opera','notion','Telegram','WhatsApp','Skype','Zoom','Webex','Dropbox','GoogleDriveFS','OneDriveStandaloneUpdater','AnyDesk','TeamViewer','parsecd','obs64','ShareX','Lightshot'); foreach($n in $names){ Get-Process -Name $n -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Write-Output 'Extended launcher/updater pack completed.'

items.name: Process Lab: RGB / Peripheral Bloat Pack (Extended)
items.description: Closes extended RGB/peripheral vendor processes.

steps.command: $names=@('iCUE','Corsair.Service','Corsair.Service.CpuIdRemote64','Corsair.Service.DisplayAdapter','LGHUB','lghub_agent','lghub_updater','Razer Synapse 3','RzSynapse','RazerCortex','Razer Axon','RzSDKServer','SteelSeriesGG','SteelSeriesSonar','SteelSeriesMoments','ArmouryCrate.UserSessionHelper','ArmourySocketServer','ASUSOptimization','LightingService','MSI.CentralServer','MSI.TerminalServer','Mystic_Light_Service','NZXT CAM','OMENCommandCenterBackground'); foreach($n in $names){ Get-Process -Name $n -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Write-Output 'Extended RGB/peripheral pack completed.'

items.name: Process Lab: Overlay / Capture Killer Pack (Extended)
items.description: Closes extended overlay/capture and related gaming helper processes.

steps.command: $names=@('NVIDIA Share','NVIDIA Web Helper','nvsphelper64','AMDSoftware','AMDRSServ','RadeonSoftware','GameBarFTServer','DiscordHookHelper','OverwolfBrowser','CurseForge','MedalEncoder','Outplayed','Wallpaper32','Wallpaper64','RTSS','MSIAfterburner'); foreach($n in $names){ Get-Process -Name $n -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Write-Output 'Extended overlay/capture pack completed.'

items.name: Process Lab: Audio Vendor Bloat Pack (Extended)
items.description: Closes extended audio-vendor process set (Nahimic/A-Volute/DTS/Dolby/Sonic Studio).

steps.command: $names=@('NahimicService','NahimicCompanion','A-Volute.Nahimic','AVoluteSS3Svc','DTSAPO4Service','DTSXUltra','DolbyDAX2API','DolbyVision','SS2Svc32','SS2Svc64'); foreach($n in $names){ Get-Process -Name $n -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Write-Output 'Extended audio vendor pack completed.'

items.name: Audio: Pure Windows Audio Path
items.description: Disables common vendor enhancement services while leaving core Windows audio services enabled.

items.name: Audio: Restart AudioDG / Audio Engine
items.description: Restarts Windows audio engine stack after changing audio tweaks.

steps.command: Get-Process -Name audiodg -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Restart-Service -Name Audiosrv -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Restart-Service -Name AudioEndpointBuilder -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Output 'Audio engine restart requested.'

items.name: Audio: Startup Junk Scanner
items.description: Scans startup/services for common Nahimic/A-Volute/DTS/Dolby/SS3 footprints.

steps.command: $patterns='Nahimic|A-Volute|AVolute|DTS|Dolby|SS2|SS3'; Write-Output '=== Services ==='; Get-Service | Where-Object { $_.Name -match $patterns -or $_.DisplayName -match $patterns } | Select-Object Name,Status,StartType | Format-Table -AutoSize; Write-Output '=== Startup Commands ==='; Get-CimInstance Win32_StartupCommand -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -match $patterns -or $_.Command -match $patterns } | Select-Object Name,Command,Location | Format-Table -AutoSize

items.name: Storage: Increase NtfsMemoryUsage
items.description: Sets NTFS memory usage mode to 2 (RAM-rich systems recommended).

items.name: Storage: ContigFileAllocSize (Experimental)
items.description: Sets ContigFileAllocSize to encourage larger contiguous allocation chunks.

items.name: Storage: Hard Storage Sense Kill
items.description: Disables Storage Sense policy and related scheduled tasks.

items.name: Services: Mixed Reality / Shared Reality Kill Pack
items.description: Disables common Mixed Reality services and tasks for non-VR rigs.

items.name: Services: Full Troubleshooting Stack Disable
items.description: Disables troubleshooting helpers and diagnostics policy service stack.

items.name: Services: Maintenance Stack Hard-Off
items.description: Disables automatic maintenance policy + key maintenance tasks.

items.name: Services: AppX / ClipSVC Split (Store Disabled, Shell Survival)
items.description: Disables ClipSVC/WSService while leaving AppXSVC manual for shell safety.

items.name: Services: AppX / ClipSVC Split (Full AppX Kill)
items.description: Hard profile disabling AppXSVC, ClipSVC, and WSService.

items.name: Services: Contact / Messaging / Sync Stack Remover
items.description: Disables common sync/contact user-services used by cloud account workflows.

items.name: Services: Bluetooth Full-Hardcore Pack
items.description: Disables Bluetooth core and related user-service stack for wired-only builds.

items.name: Services: Wi-Fi Full-Hardcore Pack (Soft Disable)
items.description: Stops WLAN service for Ethernet-only sessions without permanently stripping adapter state.

items.name: Services: Wi-Fi Full-Hardcore Pack (Hard Disable)
items.description: Disables WLAN AutoConfig for pure wired-only rigs.

items.name: Services: Restore Wi-Fi Profile
items.description: Restores WLAN AutoConfig startup mode after hardcore network stripping.

items.name: Network: LAN-Only Stripped Preset
items.description: Disables SSDP/UPnP and legacy discovery helpers for pure Ethernet rigs.

items.name: Network: Active Probe Minimizer
items.description: Reduces active network probing/NCSI chatter.

items.name: Network Profile: Game-Download Mode
items.description: Throughput-oriented profile that keeps update/download related networking services available.

items.name: Network Profile: Comp-Latency Mode
items.description: Low-background-chatter profile for tournament sessions.

items.name: Shell: Disable Cloud-Optimized Content Surfaces
items.description: Disables cloud content and suggestion surfaces in Windows shell.

items.name: Safety: Snapshot Before Extreme Preset
items.description: Creates export snapshots for services, task list, and selected registry branches before extreme tweaks.

steps.command: $dir=Join-Path (Get-Location) 'FalconSnapshots'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null; $ts=Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'; Get-Service | Sort-Object Name | Select-Object Name,Status,StartType | Export-Csv -NoTypeInformation -Path (Join-Path $dir ("services_$ts.csv")); schtasks /query /fo LIST /v > (Join-Path $dir ("tasks_$ts.txt")); reg export 'HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services' (Join-Path $dir ("services_reg_$ts.reg")) /y | Out-Null; reg export 'HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Schedule\TaskCache' (Join-Path $dir ("taskcache_$ts.reg")) /y | Out-Null; bcdedit /enum all > (Join-Path $dir ("bcd_$ts.txt")); Write-Output ("Snapshot saved to: {0}" -f $dir)

items.name: Safety: Protected Verify Card
items.description: Reads back protected service/task state to verify hardcore cards actually applied.

steps.command: $svc='StateRepository','ClipSVC','SSDPSRV','WlanSvc','bthserv'; foreach($s in $svc){ $o=Get-Service -Name $s -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if($o){ Write-Output ("Service {0}: Status={1}; StartType={2}" -f $o.Name,$o.Status,$o.StartType) } else { Write-Output ("Service {0}: not found" -f $s) } }; $tasks='\Microsoft\Windows\TaskScheduler\Regular Maintenance','\Microsoft\Windows\DiskCleanup\SilentCleanup','\Microsoft\Windows\StorageSense\StorageSense'; foreach($t in $tasks){ schtasks /query /tn $t /fo LIST /v 2>$null | Select-String 'TaskName:|Scheduled Task State:' | ForEach-Object { $_.ToString() } }

items.name: Analyzer: Conflict Scanner
items.description: Detects common tuning conflicts (Armoury Crate, Nahimic, iCUE, Logitech/Razer overlays, VBS/Memory Integrity, virtualization).

steps.command: $proc='ArmouryCrate.UserSessionHelper','NahimicService','iCUE','LGHUB','RzSynapse','Discord','RTSS','MSIAfterburner'; Write-Output '=== Running process conflicts ==='; foreach($p in $proc){ if(Get-Process -Name $p -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue){ Write-Output ("FOUND process: {0}" -f $p) } }; Write-Output '=== VBS / HVCI ==='; Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_DeviceGuard -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object SecurityServicesConfigured,SecurityServicesRunning,VirtualizationBasedSecurityStatus | Format-List; Write-Output '=== Hyper-V/Virtualization Features ==='; Get-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.FeatureName -match 'Hyper|VirtualMachinePlatform|Containers|WindowsHypervisorPlatform' } | Select-Object FeatureName,State | Format-Table -AutoSize
